title: heavenly herbed russian courgettes gratin
description: a flavorful, low-carb gratin dish that combines the sweetness of courgettes with the savory taste of herbs. perfect as a keto-friendly dinner option.
instructions: preheat the raclette-grill to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
slice the courgettes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
in a large bowl, toss the courgette slices with the softened butter, garlic, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper.
place a layer of courgette slices in the raclette-grill, followed by a sprinkle of gruyere cheese.
repeat the layering process until all the ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
transfer the raclette-grill to the oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove the raclette-grill from the oven and top with chopped chives, if using.
let the gratin rest for 5 minutes before serving.
serve hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
